Name: (AT) Everia's Dragons
Author: CritMe20
Description:
[b]This is an Alternative Textures conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4467]Everia's Dragons[/url] mod.

[/b]In order for this mod to work you need to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] downloaded and added into your mods file.
There are twelve variations of dragons which are Everia's original
design. This mod only changes the textures of your cows!

[b]Installation
[/b]1.Download and extract the files.
2.Put the main folder in "Mods".

[b]How to change textures
[/b]1. Purchase Scissors from Robin.
2. Use the Scissors tool to apply your chosen texture to entities, in this case your cows.

For more information regarding Alternative Textures and its tools visit their mod site linked above!
[b]You can find a Content Patcher and Better Farm Animal Variety versions from Everia's own Nexusmods profile linked above![/b]

Downloads.Description: This is an add-on for Alternative Textures and won't work without the mod, for BFAV and CP files go to the original author's site linked in description.
